description: All-in-one fast agent utility pack: UUID v4 & v7 batch, UTC/timezone timestamps, crypto random tokens & integers, HTTP status code catalog (incl. 402), and SHA-256 / Keccak-256 / Base64url hashes. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

count.description: how many UUIDs or random ints to generate (1-25)

input.description: optional string up to 4096 chars to hash and encode

op.description: operation subset: all (default), uuid, time, random, http, or hash

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: utility_pack
title: Utility pack
